description: Defines a class for an angular pointing marker in a graph rendering library, extending a base pointing marker class. Implements drawing logic for a marker with a specified radius and directional calculations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Angular
classes.description: A marker class that points away from the graph with a specified radius, extending the base pointing marker class.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Angular
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the angular marker with a radius and end marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the angular marker on the canvas, calculating delta X and Y based on values and drawing parameters.
